**Goal `ext-image`, Stage 2 (the build): the image component is embedded, loads with no entry and no pin, compiles on first use, and its digest is in `env_hash`; nothing in `nvs serve` or `nvs run` loads it yet.** The design is settled by ADR 0120, ADR 0247 and the goal file's § *Standing decisions*; no session re-decides one.

`nvs_ext::load::Loader::builtins` reads each built-in component's sections and world without compiling, and `Builtin::extension` compiles it once (through the loader's `ModuleCache`, keyed by the build-time digest) and runs checks 5 to 7 with `Novis\` admitted. `load_bytes` and `Builtin::extension` share `Loader::check`. The packed image component passes every check as it is: `manifest.json` matched the export, and a real `info` call on a PNG returns its format and size (`crates/nvs-ext/tests/builtin.rs`, the four tests the record names, green).

`nvs_config::cache::set_built_in` records the built-in digests once per process, and `env_hash` folds them; `nvs_ext::builtin::fold_into_env_hash` is called first thing in `crates/nvs-cli/src/main.rs` `main`. The check `two_builds_with_different_built_in_component_bytes_key_apart` is in `crates/nvs-config/src/cache.rs`'s test module.

Still red in Stage 2: the conformance case, the `webp-lib` tool and its test, `--check-c-deps` for libwebp, and the attribution test.

items.text: **`nvs serve` and `nvs run` load the built-in set** (`rule:packaging/the-first-party-components-are-built-in`) — the process loader `crates/nvs-cli/src/extensions.rs:225` calls `Loader::builtins` before any `[[extension]]` entry, and the compiler sees each `Builtin::manifest` beside the entries' manifests, so `use Novis\Image\Codec` resolves with no `nvs.toml`. A call reaches `Builtin::extension` (`crates/nvs-ext/src/load.rs:560`) and only then compiles.

**The conformance case** — `tests/conformance/novis/image-info-answers-with-no-configuration.nvst`, once the compiler's manifest read `crates/nvs-cli/src/extensions.rs:198` carries the built-in manifests: a program with no `nvs.toml` calls `Novis\Image\Codec::info` (or `Novis\Image\Image::info` if the Novis source half exists by then) on PNG bytes it writes itself, and prints the width and height.

**The libwebp tool** (`rule:packaging/a-prebuilt-wasm-library-is-rebuilt-in-ci`) — `tools/nv/cmd/webp-lib.ts` with `--check`, shaped like `tools/nv/cmd/gen-attribution.ts:274`, `tools/nv/test/webp-lib.test.ts`, then `bun nv gen-attribution --check-c-deps` and `tools/nv/test/attribution-extensions.test.ts`. A separate file set: take it in its own session.
